summary: @or-sdk/accounts preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which locates or downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`), extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (obfuscator.io-style shuffled string array of ~1000 opaque tokens, no plaintext logic) whose filename does not correspond to any accounts-SDK functionality. `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0xXXXX` identifier obfuscation. Executing the payload through Bun rather than Node avoids Node-based install-time analyzers. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` via the lifecycle hook, executing attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
